fusions.name: Stampede Front
fusions.desc: Drives forward through a wide cone 4 tiles long, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Yoke-Breaker
fusions.desc: A heavy, even blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Ruminate
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd Endurance

riders.text: the small hurts close on their own
you get your breath back between things
and everything you have comes round again sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
